description: An Electron Windows build with a custom NSIS fork fails after upgrading electron-builder to v27 because the custom NSIS config moved to toolsets, from https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/10274.
prompt:
My Windows installer build started failing after I tried electron-builder 27. We use a patched NSIS for a 4 GiB asset-heavy app and I think the build is ignoring it now.

```
⨯ C:\Users\Me\AppData\Local\electron-builder\Cache\nsis@1.2.1\nsis-bundle-3.12-wfwns\makensis.cmd process failed ERR_ELECTRON_BUILDER_CANNOT_EXECUTE
Exit code: 1
```
